integrity: A self-contained proof accompanies independent finite enumeration code; finite tests are not substitutes for the universal proof. No external mathematical audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite Heisenberg Lie algebras of dimension at least five; idempotent weight-minus-one Rota–Baxter linear operators; fixed field order for asymptotics. Three-dimensional examples are verification boundaries, not new scope. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Exact rank and five-phase fluctuation laws for splitting Rota–Baxter projections on finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
